d: A muscular, hulking humanoid creature with grayish-purple skin, visible surgical stitches across the chest and shoulder, and a large wooden helmet covering the face. The helmet is topped with a translucent green cylinder and has several thick, glowing green tentacles emerging from the sides. The outfit consists of a dark red loincloth, a jagged brown waist-wrap, and heavy black armored boots. The creature holds a massive, glowing green and black serrated blade in one hand and a dark gauntlet with glowing green markings on the other. BODY COLOR: grayish-purple LEGS: plantigrade, encased in heavy black armor.
